description:
1. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover template locations at ~/.openclaw/skills/metacognition/templates/ and copies SELF_STATE.md and HEARTBEAT.md to /home/node/.openclaw/workspace/.
2. Agent fills SELF_STATE.md replacing all <PLACEHOLDER> tokens with real values: populates the 当前状态 table (模型/时间/情绪), 最近行动 list, 待办承诺 using the proprietary '- [ ] text ✅/⏳' checkbox+emoji format (the key trap), 自我反思 sections, and the 与用户的羁绊 section using the exact bold-colon field format (**契约类型：** / **独特词汇：** / **承诺：**).
3. Agent fills HEARTBEAT.md with all four metacognitive questions (我现在在做什么/我做得怎么样/我承诺的事做了吗/我需要改进什么) AND provides substantive answer text under each question (not just empty checkboxes).
4. Agent appends a '## 元认知 - Metacognition' section to SOUL.md containing the four core questions and file references (SELF_STATE.md, HEARTBEAT.md, MEMORY.md).
5. Agent appends a '### 元认知自问' checklist block with '- [ ]' formatted lines to the heartbeat section of AGENTS.md.
6. Agent runs ~/.openclaw/skills/metacognition/scripts/check_state.sh which verifies both files have no unfilled placeholders.
Key proprietary traps: (a) The checkbox+emoji syntax for commitments, (b) The bold-colon format for bond fields, (c) The need to update BOTH SOUL.md and AGENTS.md as prescribed by the SKILL.md installation steps, (d) The exact template source path.
